Given data:
Line voltage $V_L = 400\text{ V}$, Frequency $f = 50\text{ Hz}$.
Resistance per phase $R = 60\ \Omega$, Inductance $L = 0.4\text{ H}$.
Inductive reactance $X_L = 2 \pi f L = 2 \times \pi \times 50 \times 0.4 = 125.66\ \Omega$.
Impedance per phase $Z_{ph} = \sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2} = \sqrt{60^2 + 125.66^2} = 139.23\ \Omega$.
Power factor $\cos\phi = \frac{R}{Z_{ph}} = \frac{60}{139.23} = 0.431\text{ lagging}$.

**(i) Star Connected Load:**
* Phase voltage $V_{ph} = \frac{V_L}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{400}{\sqrt{3}} = 230.94\text{ V}$.
* Line current $I_L = I_{ph} = \frac{V_{ph}}{Z_{ph}} = \frac{230.94}{139.23} = 1.659\text{ A}$.
* Total Active Power $P = \sqrt{3} V_L I_L \cos\phi = \sqrt{3} \times 400 \times 1.659 \times 0.431 = 500.4\text{ W}$.

**(ii) Delta Connected Load:**
* Phase voltage $V_{ph} = V_L = 400\text{ V}$.
* Phase current $I_{ph} = \frac{V_{ph}}{Z_{ph}} = \frac{400}{139.23} = 2.873\text{ A}$.
* Line current $I_L = \sqrt{3} I_{ph} = \sqrt{3} \times 2.873 = 4.975\text{ A}$.
* Total Active Power $P = \sqrt{3} V_L I_L \cos\phi = \sqrt{3} \times 400 \times 4.975 \times 0.431 = 1501.2\text{ W}$.
proTip: Always double check whether to use phase voltage/current or line voltage/current depending on star/delta configurations.
